question: What part of currently authorized MAP-001 can be represented with TILE-GRAMMAR-CANDIDATE-v0.2 without inference, what must remain OPEN, and what reveals a REPRESENTATIONAL_GAP?
prohibited: using validatePatch() 3x3 as the MAP-001 integration gate
promoting the provisional raster to authoritative walkableEnvelope
auto-deriving blocker edge signatures from sideContainment
inferring metric scale or geographic cardinality
encoding bridge/gate/house as terrain semantics unless a separate authorized overlay contract exists
treating test scaffolding as MAP-001 evidence or authority

mappingTargets.target: route.kind=path + route.ports on shared walkable edges
mappingTargets.limitation: proves local declarative route connectivity only, not pathfinding or global navigation
tile grammar v0.2 has edge route ports but no semantic entry/exit progression role
normalization may use integer 0 only as relative code, never meters

mappingTargets.target: specific blocker edges / hard blocker cells

requiredFixtures.purpose: derive the 17 provisional walkable cells into logical route cells and validate all shared route adjacencies with validateTile()/validateEdgeMatch()
normalize MAP-001 path reference-band to a relative integer code without metric claim
verify that stream polyline does not automatically produce water/bank edge signatures
verify that sideContainment does not automatically produce blocker edge signatures
record screen_up exit and screen_down entry without falsely claiming tile grammar v0.2 represents progressionRole
verify bridge/gate/house, interactionLearning and camera are retained outside terrain grammar mapping

decisionRules.PASS: all SOURCE_EXPLICIT / DERIVED / NORMALIZED mappings behave as declared; all OPEN/OUT_OF_SCOPE boundaries remain preserved; no prohibited inference occurs; no material representational gap is found within tile-grammar scope
decisionRules.REVISE: a false positive, false negative, unjustified normalization, or correctable under-specification appears without requiring replacement of the candidate model
decisionRules.INSUFFICIENT: a material MAP-001 requirement that belongs inside terrain grammar cannot be represented without extending or replacing the current grammar
